description: Read a Panel's current identity and values, kept apart (identity: what it is, e.g. heading, label, link; values: prices, counts, times), with its state and how fresh the read is. Banquish reloads an unloaded page if needed. To protect sites, values read under a minute ago are served as they are, and an unloaded page is reloaded at most every 5 minutes: reads in between get the last values, stale since they were read. A not-responding Panel's page isn't reloaded for a read: it waits for the user to reload it.
name: read_panel
